subject: dynamic UI, multiple workers and connections

messages.author: f957fda17cafa763
messages.subject: dynamic UI, multiple workers and connections
parts:
Hello,
Please could someone help me better understand the interplay of dynamic UIs in Shiny with multiple workers and connections in Shinyapps.
I have a dynamic UI which includes a text area into which users are asked to type a response to a question. I've put this Shiny App on shinyapps.io with max workers = 10, and max connections = 50.
Some users have reported that the contents of the text area changes even if they are not typing. Presumably that's because they've obtained different connections to the same worker? If so, is the solution to reduce max connections to 1, to ensure that it's a single user connected to a single worker?
many thanks in advance,
Andrew
